note: simulation only; no hardware addressed and no approval bound
why_this_timestep: NO timestep change required. This trace runs at the model's shipped dt=0.005. The earlier conclusion that dt=0.005 is unstable at every gain was a coarse-grid artifact: its kd values jumped 10 -> 15, skipping the stable band kd=8..10.

erratum.false_claim: At the shipped dt=0.005 the PD loop is unstable at every gain; dt must be lowered to 0.002.
erratum.correction: A 63-point fine sweep at dt=0.005 found stable holds at kp=200..400 with kd=8..10. At kp=200/kd=10 the 1000-step hold has 2.3 mm root drift, 4.52 deg tilt, 0.058 rad/s max joint velocity.
erratum.root_cause_of_error: Coarse grid: kd in {10,15,20,25,30}; kd=10 sagged at low kp, kd>=15 exploded, so the stable high-kp/low-kd region was never sampled.
erratum.old_trace: not invalid — it is a valid PASS at dt=0.002, but its stated reason for changing dt was wrong.

sweep_evidence.integrator_check: At kp=200/kd=20, switching integrator (implicit/RK4/Euler) does not fix it — the fix is the gain band, not the integrator.
